testcase.name: GI benchmark browser propagation at 50/500 Hz with one/four subscribers
GI-01/17/20 real browser streams, two games, output encoding and unlocked cleanup
GI-10/16 silence neutralizes controls, recovery retains game and waits for explicit continuation
GI-10/20 physical reconnect uses the same game facade and does not replay old counts
GI-20 a native readable stream replacement recovers without another chooser
GI-14/20 unsupported board and denied chooser produce a usable error and no game
sensor checks retain a one-snapshot shake and distinguish zero light from unavailable input
image editor paints locally, sends row-major brightness values and keeps draft separate from board clear
piano and tone controls send selected frequencies, octave, duration and volume
melodies and advertised sounds can be selected; invalid settings never send commands
